title: Ex 1.3 #3 · Subsets of {{ℝ}}
prompt: List all the subsets of $\{\{\mathbb{R}\}\}$. Enter them together as one set of sets between outer braces, like $\{\emptyset, \{1\}\}$.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: This set has exactly one element: the set {ℝ}.
A set with k elements has 2ᵏ subsets, including ∅ and the set itself: here that's 2.
solution: The set has 1 element(s), so it has 2 subset(s), from ∅ up to the whole set.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
